senses: to bear news, bear tidings, publish, preach, show forth
to announce (salvation) as good news, preach

strongs.def: properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news)
strongs.kjv: messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings
